title: Swear-Jar Ledger and Worst Days
dataSources: Alcohol drinks (`alcohol:drink`), vice logs (`vice:log`), hydration intake (`hydration:intake`), swear-jar entries (`swearjar:entry`).
app: Habit and sobriety trackers, alcohol-unit and hydration logs, vaping/smoking cessation apps, and a smart swear jar — sent to Splunk HEC via scripted inputs and MQTT.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=swearjar:entry
| bin _time span=1d
| stats count as swears, sum(fine) as owed by _time
| sort - swears
description: Counts the swear-jar entries each day and totals what you owe, a light-hearted nudge to clean up your language.
value: A running swear-jar tally is a fun accountability game that turns a bad habit into a charity donation.
implementation: Log swear-jar taps (a button by the jar) into `index=personal`; review daily counts and fines owed.
visualization: Column chart of daily swear count with fines owed.
grandmaExplanation: It counts your swear-jar slip-ups and adds up what you owe, a fun way to watch your language.
